321. ASCII Sum of String

60

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given a string S convert each characters of the string into ASCII values and print the sum of the numbers.
input_spec: The input consists of a string S with a maximum length of 100000 characters.
output_spec: The output is a single integer representing the sum of the ASCII values of all characters in the input string.
